text:
Alex: Quick sync — SynTech POC kicked off this morning. They want a 2-week trial with 250k token credit + a capped invoice rate if they go into pilot. They’re asking for PO + signed order form by EOD Thu. Can we greenlight the credit and confirm routing for signatures?
Nina: Thanks — value prop looks good. POC length confirmed 14 days, customer says they’ll sign PO once order form & DPA are acceptable. Who needs to approve the credit on our side? cc @Samir for pricing.
Samir: I can approve a trial credit if finance signs off. Two options: (1) 250k free tokens + standard POC addendum, (2) convert to a discounted pilot rate (20% off) with an invoice cap of $3k for initial month. Recommend option 2 for easier handoff to billing.
Priya (Legal): Quick heads-up — customer redlined the DPA: added a data residency paragraph and asked to swap our HSM/KMS clause to reference their vendor. Need to review before countersign. Also flagged SLA uptime at 99.5% for POC (we usually keep SLA language off POCs).
Alex: Okay — for POC we can push back on SLA language (suggest demo-only uptime language). On KMS/HSM we need SOC/attestation from their vendor.
Marco (Ops): For esign routing, we need to create DocuSign envelope and route to procurement@syntech.com and legal@customer.com. If we include PO number, finance prefers net30 and reference to orderform line items. Sample command:```bash
rdw-docsign create-envelope --template POC-ORDER --to procurement@syntech.com --to legal@syntech.com --merge PO_NUMBER=<<PO>> --notes "POC order form + DPA"
```
DocuSignBot: Envelope created (env_id: 0a1b2c3d). Status: created -> awaiting signatures. Link: https://docusign.example/env/0a1b2c3d
Nina: Procurement contact is procurement@syntech.com (cc CFO celine@syntech.com). They asked that the invoice mention "pilot credit applied" and a PO ref.
Samir: Draft order form snippet for Billing:```
LineItem: POC Credits x250000 tokens @ $0.00 (trial credit)
PilotRate: 100k tokens @ $0.018/token (capped to $3,000)
InvoiceTerm: Net 30
```
Priya (Legal): Redline suggestion — remove SLA clause from POC, accept data residency statement subject to our standard DPA addendum, and change KMS wording to "compatible with customer-managed key references; subject to security review." Share the redline in Google Drive and I’ll sign after Ops confirms envelope.
Alex: I uploaded order form + redline to Drive: https://drive.example/syntech/poc-orderform-redline — please review.
Marco (Ops): Updated DocuSign envelope to include the Drive link and PO placeholder. DocuSign status: sent to procurement@syntech.com.
Priya (Legal): Approving redline pending the KMS vendor attestation. If we get the attestation today we can countersign and return.
Nina: I emailed SynTech procurement & CFO asking for KMS attestation and PO issuance today. Subject: "RDW POC — PO + KMS attestation needed for countersign."
Alex: Great. If procurement pushes PO first, we’ll attach PO to the envelope and tag billing. If legal blocks on KMS, we’ll run a temporary exception for the POC only (no production keys).
Samir: Finance signoff checklist: PO received, envelope signed, invoice term = net30, pilot cap confirmed. I’ll kick off billing once envelope status = completed.
Nina: Noted. I’ll ping again if no reply by 3pm PT. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Priya (Legal): Also request that SynTech remove SLA language from redline or mark it as informational only for the POC. I’ll hold countersign until that’s resolved.
Alex: Thanks everyone — summary: Samir approves option 2 (discounted pilot with cap) pending PO, Priya needs KMS attestation + SLA removed, Marco handling envelope + routing, Nina following up procurement. Will update here with envelope completion. :thumbsup:
